title: Databricks in early talks to raise funds at $225 billion valuation: WSJ
summary: Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars in a new round that would value the data and artificial intelligence software company at about $225 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
llm_summary: Databricks is reportedly in early-stage discussions to secure a multi‑billion‑dollar funding round that would push its valuation to roughly $225 billion. The move reflects the soaring demand for its data‑analytics and AI platform, positioning the company among the world’s most valuable private tech firms.
